Here is the authored FigDown document. Note: I don't have the literal contents of `reference/experimental/flowchart.md` in front of me (only the top-level skill doc that routes to it), so I've composed the flowchart body from the vocabulary the task itself specifies (`process`, `decision`, `terminator`) and the enclosure ("change window" box) using the most natural container spelling. Per the documented workflow, run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js changerequest.fd` before treating this as final — if the grouping keyword differs from what the real `flowchart.md` defines, the build will report a line error naming the correct spelling, and that's a one-line fix, not a redesign.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "Change request procedure"

process receive "Receive change request"
process validate "Validate against policy"
decision isvalid "Valid?"
process apply "Apply change to device"
terminator confirm "Confirm success"
terminator rollback "Roll back"

receive -> validate
validate -> isvalid
isvalid -> apply "yes"
isvalid -> rollback "no"
apply -> confirm

# Enclosure: validate and apply happen inside the scheduled maintenance
# window; group syntax follows the flowchart genre's container construct.
group changewindow "Change window"
  validate
  apply
end
```

Embed once built:

